title: Gluets' Ptions
description: Update the lackluster Potions of Minecraft!
body:
Gluets' Potions is a small datapack I produced to get back into the flow of making silly little things. This datapack brings the old school, almost untouched, potions into the modern minecraft PvP age with a few subtle changes to their overall workings, and some more specific changes to each individual potion.

Freshly crafted Bottled Potions can now stack up to 16, allowing you to bring many more potions on your travels, you can even use a bundle to hold a variety of potions in a single slot. Most potion durations however have been decreased to account for the sheer quantity of potions you can now carry on your person, though more adventurous effects like Water Breathing now last even longer than Vanilla.

Splash and Lingering potions also received changes, now stacking up to 8. When you use a Splash or Lingering potion, all throwable potions of the same effect go into a very short cooldown to prevent spamming. This allowed me to boost the strength of a lot of the more offensive potions.

![All the changes made to potions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c1b6c561afed8ad579bba9920528f0aa1a0c274.png)

The base potions, Mundane, Awkward and Thick are now a little more useful, providing effects that aren't often accessible in survival with Blindness, Nausea and Hunger respectively. These potions can still be crafted into Splash and Lingering bottles, and would be pretty effective for getting the jump on an unsuspecting enemy player. All base potions can also now be used to craft the other potions, not just Awkward, so if you accidentally make something Mundane or Thick it's not so troublesome.

![Potions now vary in colour depending on their ingredients](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19a76c044c8d6efbece9f40ca908c5745040a9ec.png)
